name: Krila
source: What is the novel about? Everything is very simple! About the girl Marie, who is stuck in a traumatic situation. The girl's psyche tries to protect itself from even more trauma by escaping from reality. Where will it lead her? Will she be able to adapt to a new place - in an orphanage - and solve all its secrets?
translation: 小说讲了什么？一切都很简单！关于陷入创伤境地的女孩玛丽。女孩的心灵试图通过逃避现实来保护自己免受更多创伤。它将把她引向何方？她能否适应新的地方——孤儿院——并解开其中的所有秘密？
